<script>
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
    const track = document.getElementById("partnersTrack");
    const marquee = document.getElementById("partnersMarquee");

    if (!track || !marquee) return;

    // Clone items for seamless loop
    const items = track.children;
    const itemsArray = Array.from(items);

    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
      itemsArray.forEach((item) => {
        const clone = item.cloneNode(true);
        track.appendChild(clone);
      });
    }

    let position = 0;
    const speed = 0.5;
    const itemWidth = 200 + 20;
    const totalWidth = itemWidth * itemsArray.length;

    function animate() {
      position -= speed;

      if (Math.abs(position) >= totalWidth) {
        position = 0;
      }

      track.style.transform = `translateX(${position}px)`;
      requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    }

    animate();
  });
</script>

<script>
// Enhanced Scroll Effect with Shimmer
let lastScrollTop = 0;
window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
    const scrollTop = window.pageYOffset || document.documentElement.scrollTop;
    const header = document.getElementById('header');
    if (scrollTop > 50) {
        header.classList.add('scrolled');
    } else {
        header.classList.remove('scrolled');
    }
    lastScrollTop = scrollTop;
});

// Mobile Menu Toggle
function toggleMobileMenu() {
    const nav = document.querySelector('.header-nav-main');
    const toggleBtn = document.querySelector('.mobile-toggle');
    if (!nav || !toggleBtn) return;
    nav.classList.toggle('show');
    const isExpanded = nav.classList.contains('show');
    toggleBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', isExpanded);
    const icon = toggleBtn.querySelector('i');
    if (icon) {
        icon.className = isExpanded ? 'fas fa-times' : 'fas fa-bars';
    }
    // Close all dropdowns on toggle
    document.querySelectorAll('.dropdown.active').forEach(d => d.classList.remove('active'));
    // Prevent body scroll when menu is open
    document.body.style.overflow = isExpanded ? 'hidden' : '';
}

// Search Toggle
function toggleSearch() {
    const dropdown = document.querySelector('.search-dropdown');
    if (dropdown) {
        dropdown.style.display = dropdown.style.display === 'block' ? 'none' : 'block';
    }
}

// Language Change
function change_lang(langCode) {
    const form = document.querySelector("#id_lang_selector_form");
    if (form) {
        const input = document.createElement('input');
        input.type = 'hidden';
        input.name = 'language';
        input.value = langCode;
        form.appendChild(input);
        form.submit();
    }
}

// Mobile dropdown click handler
function handleMobileDropdownClick(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const dropdown = e.currentTarget.closest('.dropdown');
    if (!dropdown) return;
    // Close other dropdowns
    document.querySelectorAll('.dropdown.active').forEach(d => {
        if (d !== dropdown) d.classList.remove('active');
    });
    dropdown.classList.toggle('active');
}

// DOM Ready Enhancements
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    var heroCarousel = document.getElementById('heroCarousel');
    if (heroCarousel) {
        new bootstrap.Carousel(heroCarousel, {
            interval: 7000,
            wrap: true,
            keyboard: true
        });
    }

    // Close mobile menu on link click
    document.querySelectorAll('.nav-link, .dropdown-item, .mega-link, .lang-option').forEach(link => {
        link.addEventListener('click', () => {
            if (window.innerWidth < 992) {
                toggleMobileMenu();
                document.querySelectorAll('.dropdown.active').forEach(d => d.classList.remove('active'));
            }
        });
    });

    // Language selector handling
    document.querySelectorAll('.lang-option').forEach(option => {
        option.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            const langCode = option.getAttribute('data-lang');
            change_lang(langCode);
        });
    });

    // Setup for mobile dropdowns
    function setupMobileDropdowns() {
        const links = document.querySelectorAll('.dropdown > .nav-link, .lang-selector .lang-toggle');
        const isMobile = window.innerWidth < 992;
        if (isMobile) {
            links.forEach(link => {
                link.addEventListener('click', handleMobileDropdownClick);
            });
        } else {
            links.forEach(link => {
                link.removeEventListener('click', handleMobileDropdownClick);
            });
        }
    }
    setupMobileDropdowns();

    // Close dropdowns and search on outside click
    document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        if (!e.target.closest('.dropdown') && !e.target.closest('.header-utilities')) {
            document.querySelectorAll('.dropdown.active').forEach(d => d.classList.remove('active'));
            const searchDropdown = document.querySelector('.search-dropdown');
            if (searchDropdown) searchDropdown.style.display = 'none';
        }
    });

    // Enhanced Resize handler
    let resizeTimeout;
    window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
        clearTimeout(resizeTimeout);
        resizeTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
            const nav = document.querySelector('.header-nav-main');
            const toggleBtn = document.querySelector('.mobile-toggle');
            const isMobile = window.innerWidth < 992;
            if (!isMobile) {
                if (nav) nav.classList.remove('show');
                document.querySelectorAll('.dropdown.active').forEach(d => d.classList.remove('active'));
                if (toggleBtn) {
                    toggleBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
                    const icon = toggleBtn.querySelector('i');
                    if (icon) icon.className = 'fas fa-bars';
                }
                document.body.style.overflow = '';
            }
            setupMobileDropdowns();
        }, 150);
    });

    // Keyboard navigation for accessibility
    document.querySelectorAll('.nav-link, .dropdown-item, .mega-link, .lang-option').forEach(link => {
        link.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
                e.preventDefault();
                link.click();
            }
        });
    });
});
</script>
